subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): openclaw worker mode running the embedded loop on the box

question: What credential-isolation contract must `openclaw worker` enforce before model-controlled `exec` and `process` tools run on leased machines?
rationale: The intended zero-standing-credentials boundary cannot be inferred safely from tests or launcher assumptions; maintainers must choose and own the worker host/process trust model.

options.title: Use an explicit environment allowlist
options.body: Launch the worker and its shell tools with only required runtime, workspace, locale, and tunnel variables, excluding ambient credentials by construction.

options.title: Trust the prepared host environment
options.body: Allow inherited variables and document leased worker hosts as fully trusted, weakening the stated credential-free worker guarantee.

recommendation.title: Use an explicit environment allowlist
recommendation.body: Launch the worker and its shell tools with only required runtime, workspace, locale, and tunnel variables, excluding ambient credentials by construction.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the cloud-worker design and authored the merged security-sensitive protocol series plus this composition runtime.
